title: Read release obligations before execution
when: Before starting or reviewing a release, including a replacement run after failed QA.
need: Read Item QA on Shipping and run detail. Not started is an obligation without qualified proof. Authorized takeover retains existing passes, failures and unfinished walks under the successor, without waivers or replay. Continue an existing execution by its ID; fresh item QA resolves current completion membership and the selected target environment. Completed releases retain their delivery history.
surface: Shipping carried-item row and deployment run detail
review: Component and database tests prove projection semantics; deployed browser review must inspect both pages.
